• Program coverage data is lacking and requires improvements to monitor the equity in which supplementation programs are delivered. Robust

• Innovations in implementation science are needed in how to best deliver supplementation programs to maximize coverage among target population

• Further development of simple costing and cost optimization tools that can be applied to inform decisions related to program continued relevance and
